title: The Ultimate Local Marketing Guide for Australian Businesses

facts.fact: According to the Australian Small Business and Family Enterprise Ombudsman, small businesses account for nearly 98% of all businesses in Australia.
facts.quote: According to the [Australian Small Business and Family Enterprise Ombudsman](https://www.asbfeo.gov.au/small-business-data-portal/number-small-businesses-australia), small businesses account for nearly 98% of all businesses in Australia.

facts.fact: Local marketing, also known as neighbourhood or community marketing, is the practice of optimising a business's visibility and appeal to customers in a specific geographic area.
